counterfactuals.output:
We study the category \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{quad}}\) of functors from the category of finite-dimensional \(\mathbb F_2\)-vector spaces equipped with nondegenerate quadratic forms to vector spaces. This category provides a quadratic analogue of the classical functor category associated to finite vector spaces and is closely related to the representation theory of orthogonal groups over \(\mathbb F_2\). We investigate the structure of the standard projective objects of \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{quad}}\), giving explicit filtrations whose successive quotients are described in terms of simpler functors arising from the underlying linear category and from orthogonal-group representations. These filtrations reveal how quadratic data refine the usual polynomial behavior of functors on vector spaces.

As an application, we give a classification of polynomial functors in \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{quad}}\). We characterize polynomiality by the vanishing of suitable difference functors and show that polynomial objects admit finite filtrations governed by the corresponding polynomial functors on \(\mathbb F_2\)-vector spaces together with finite-dimensional representations of orthogonal groups. In particular, the results identify the simple and standard building blocks appearing in bounded-degree polynomial functors and clarify their relation to classical categories of strict and ordinary polynomial functors over \(\mathbb F_2\). These results establish \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{quad}}\) as a natural framework for studying functorial representation theory associated with quadratic forms in characteristic two.
